Name: Male Genderbent Voice Pack - English
Author: Mofoswaggins
Description:
[center][size=5][b][color=#ff5555]⚠ DISCLAIMER ⚠[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][i]I am not a mod developer and do not plan on future updates, as I am generally busy. I will only update the files as I see fit, or if there are simple changes pointed out in the comments. Because this is strictly an overwrite mod, I will not be creating brand-new voice files or regenerating the prior author's work. Your comments and feedback are still appreciated![/i][/center]

[center][color=#d3d3d3]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color][/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#b19cd9]✦ REQUIREMENTS ✦[/color][/b][/size][/center]
Before installing this mod, you [b]must[/b] have the following installed:
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32832]Voice Over Framework Mod[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33063]DM Voice Pack - English[/url] (by DarkMushu1)[/*]
[/list]
[center][color=#d3d3d3]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color][/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#b19cd9]✦ ABOUT THIS MOD ✦[/color][/b][/size][/center]
I originally created these voice files for personal use while playing with genderbent male character mods, as having female sprites without matching voices felt incomplete. After finishing my first batch of files, I realized other players might enjoy using them too.

This mod is a [b]direct audio overwrite[/b] of the original male voice pack created by DarkMushu1, shared with their explicit permission.

[center][color=#d3d3d3]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color][/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#b19cd9]✦ COMPATIBILITY ✦[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*][b]Game Version:[/b] Designed for Stardew Valley [b]1.6[/b] content, as DarkMushu1's original voice pack covers up to that update.[/*]
[*][b]Visual Mods:[/b] This is strictly an audio overwrite file. It does not alter any sprites, portraits, or dialogue text, making it [b]100% compatible[/b] with your genderbent visual mods of choice.[/*]
[/list]
[center][color=#d3d3d3]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color][/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#b19cd9]✦ KNOWN ISSUES ✦[/color][/b][/size][/center]
Please note that the voices are not 100% perfect. Because these genderbent versions are built directly upon previously generated audio files rather than generated from scratch, they share the same minor quirks as the base mod.

You may occasionally experience:
[list]
[*]Weirdly generated voices or audio echoes.[/*]
[*]The AI reading out symbols (asterisks, periods, commas).[/*]
[*]The AI reading internal monologues out loud. [/*]
[/list][color=#a9a9a9][i]Note: The specific voices chosen for the bachelors were based on my personal preference and represent the best fits I could find to minimize artifacting. As this is just an overwrite mod built on prior work, I do not plan on manually editing or improving these specific artifacts.[/i][/color]

[center][color=#d3d3d3]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color][/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#b19cd9]✦ FEATURES ✦[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*]Includes genderbent (female) voices for all [b]base game[/b] marriageable male bachelors and other male NPCs.[/*]
[/list]
[center][color=#d3d3d3]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color][/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#b19cd9]✦ INSTALLATION & UNINSTALLATION ✦[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[b][color=#ffcc00]Important: This is a manual overwrite mod, not a plug-and-play installation.[/color][/b]

[b]To Install:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download and install DarkMushu1's original mod, [b]DM Voice Pack - English[/b], along with all of its required dependencies.[/*]
[*]Download and extract this mod.[/*]
[*]Copy and paste the extracted folders directly into the
[code]Assets[/code]folder of the original DM Voice Pack mod, overwriting the existing files when prompted.[/*]
[/list]
[b]To Uninstall (Revert to original voices):[/b]
You have two options:
[list]
[*]Simply reinstall DarkMushu1's DM Voice Pack to overwrite my files.[/*]
[*]Extract DarkMushu1's original mod archive and copy/paste its
[code]Assets[/code]folder over your current one.[/*]
[/list]
[center][color=#d3d3d3]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color][/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#b19cd9]✦ AI & LICENSING DISCLOSURE ✦[/color][/b][/size][/center]
This project is a derivative work of the "DM Voice Pack - English" and was created with direct permission from DarkMushu1.

As stated on DarkMushu1's original mod page:
[quote]All audio in this voice pack was generated using licensed voices from ElevenLabs’ Voice Library while I held an active commercial creator license (Scale Plan). These voices are provided by professional voice actors who have chosen to share their voices publicly through ElevenLabs. Each time a library voice is used, the original voice actor receives royalties based on usage, ensuring fair compensation for their contribution. This project complies fully with ElevenLabs’ terms of service and supports ethical use of AI voice technology.[/quote]
This mod complies with fair usage as a direct audio-to-audio alteration of DarkMushu1's legally generated voice files. To create the genderbent voices, the original audio files were processed using Retrieval-based Voice Conversion (RVC) AI. The female target voices used for this RVC conversion process were sourced from publicly available pre-trained models hosted on Hugging Face Spaces.

This project was shared with the community in good faith. Should DarkMushu1 or any of the original ElevenLabs voice actors file a complaint regarding the gender-altered usage of their work, the specific voice or affected audio files in question will be appropriately removed.

[center][color=#d3d3d3]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color][/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#b19cd9]✦ CREDITS ✦[/color][/b][/size][/center]
Full credit and a huge thank you to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Darkmushu1/about-me?gameId=1303][b]DarkMushu1[/b][/url] for creating the original voice files and generously granting permission to modify and share their work.
